# Anthropic Style Template - Design Specification

> Suitable for AI/LLM tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches, and similar scenarios.

---

## I. Template Overview

| Property       | Description                                            |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Template Name** | anthropic (Anthropic Style Template)                |
| **Use Cases**  | AI tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches |
| **Design Tone** | Tech-forward, professional, modern, conclusion-first |
| **Theme Mode** | Mixed theme (dark cover/chapter + light content pages) |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property       | Value                         |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- |
| **Format**     | Standard 16:9                 |
| **Dimensions** | 1280 × 720 px                |
| **viewBox**    | `0 0 1280 720`                |
| **Safe Margins** | 60px (left/right), 50px (top/bottom) |
| **Content Area** | x: 60-1220, y: 100-670     |
| **Title Area** | y: 50-100                     |
| **Grid Base**  | 40px                          |

---

## III. Color Scheme

### Primary Colors

| Role             | Value       | Notes                            |
| ---------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------- |
| **Anthropic Orange** | `#D97757` | Brand identity, title emphasis, key data |
| **Deep Space Gray** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover background, body text, chart base |
| **Tech Blue**    | `#4A90D9`   | Flowcharts, links, interactive elements |
| **Mint Green**   | `#10B981`   | Recommended options, positive indicators, success states |
| **Coral Red**    | `#EF4444`   | Risks, cautions, warnings        |

### Neutral Colors

| Role           | Value       | Usage                  |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| **Cloud White** | `#F8FAFC`  | Card background        |
| **Border Gray** | `#E2E8F0`  | Card borders, dividers |
| **Slate Gray** | `#64748B`   | Secondary text, chart labels |
| **Pure White** | `#FFFFFF`   | Page background        |

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Stack

**Font Stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif`

### Font Size Hierarchy

| Level    | Usage            | Size   | Weight  |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------ | ------- |
| H1       | Cover main title | 56px   | Bold    |
| H2       | Page title       | 32-36px| Bold    |
| H3       | Subtitle/section | 24-28px| Semibold|
| H4       | Card title       | 20-22px| Bold    |
| P        | Body content     | 16-18px| Regular |
| Data     | Highlighted data | 40-48px| Bold    |
| Label    | Label text       | 14px   | 500     |
| Sub      | Chart labels/footnotes | 12-14px | Regular |

---

## V. Core Design Principles

### Top-Tier Consulting Style

1. **Conclusion First (Pyramid Principle)**: Each page title is the core takeaway
2. **Data Contextualization**: Comparisons, trends, benchmarks — never present data in isolation
3. **SCQA Framework**: Situation → Complication → Question → Answer
4. **MECE Principle**: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive
5. **Professional Whitespace**: Content ratio < 65%, let information "breathe"

---

## VI. Page Structure

### General Layout

| Area           | Position/Height | Description                            |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| **Top**        | y=0, h=6-8px    | Anthropic Orange decorative bar        |
| **Label**      | y=50-70         | Page type label (uppercase, orange)    |
| **Title Area** | y=80-140        | Page title (core takeaway)             |
| **Content Area** | y=160-620     | Main content area                      |
| **Footer**     | y=680           | Page number (centered)                 |

### Decorative Elements

- **Top Orange Bar**: Anthropic Orange (`#D97757`), height 6px
- **Left Gradient Bar**: Orange gradient (`#D97757` → `#E8956F`)
- **Card Border**: Light gray (`#E2E8F0`)
- **Card Shadow**: Soft shadow effect
- **Grid Decoration Lines**: White low-opacity grid on dark covers

---

## VII. Page Types

### 1. Cover Page (01_cover.svg)

- Dark gradient background (`#1A1A2E` → `#16213E` → `#0F0F1A`)
- Grid decoration lines (white, 3% opacity)
- Orange and blue glow effects
- Neural network-style connection lines and nodes
- Centered main title (white) + subtitle
- Orange decorative short line
- Bottom date and source info

### 2. Table of Contents Page (02_toc.svg)

- White background
- Left orange gradient decorative bar (8px)
- Orange circular numbers + chapter titles
- Right-side complexity progression illustration

### 3. Chapter Page (02_chapter.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Grid decoration
- Centered large chapter title
- Orange decorative line

### 4. Content Page (03_content.svg)

- White background
- Top orange decorative bar
- Page type label (orange uppercase)
- Title as core takeaway
- Three-column card layout (colored top borders)
- Footer with centered page number

### 5. Ending Page (04_ending.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Neural network decoration
- Centered thank-you message
- Contact information

---

## VIII. Common Components

### Card Style

```xml
<!-- Card with shadow -->
<g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
    <path fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1"
          d="M72,180 H408 A12,12 0 0 1 420,192 V588 A12,12 0 0 1 408,600 H72 A12,12 0 0 1 60,588 V192 A12,12 0 0 1 72,180 Z"/>
</g>
<!-- Top colored decorative bar -->
<rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981"/>
```

### Circular Number

```xml
<circle cx="90" cy="200" r="24" fill="#D97757"/>
<text x="90" y="207" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
```

### Icon Background Circle

```xml
<circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
```

---

## IX. Spacing Guidelines

| Element          | Value  |
| ---------------- | ------ |
| Safe margin      | 60px   |
| Card gap         | 30-40px|
| Card border radius | 8-12px |
| Card padding     | 30px   |
| Grid base        | 40px   |

---

## X. SVG Technical Constraints

### Mandatory Rules

1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
2. Use `<rect>` elements for backgrounds
3. Use `<tspan>` for text wrapping (**strictly no** `<foreignObject>`)
4. Use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` for transparency
5. Prohibited: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
6. Prohibited: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`
7. Define gradients using `<defs>`

### PPT Compatibility Rules

- No `<g opacity="...">` (group opacity)
- Inline styles only

---

## XI. Placeholder Specification

| Placeholder        | Description        |
| ------------------ | ------------------ |
| `{{TITLE}}`        | Main title         |
| `{{SUBTITLE}}`     | Subtitle           |
| `{{SOURCE}}`       | Source info        |
| `{{DATE}}`         | Date               |
| `{{PAGE_TITLE}}`   | Page title (core takeaway) |
| `{{PAGE_LABEL}}`   | Page type label    |
| `{{CHAPTER_NUM}}`  | Chapter number     |
| `{{CHAPTER_TITLE}}`| Chapter title      |
| `{{PAGE_NUM}}`     | Page number        |
| `{{TOTAL_PAGES}}`  | Total pages        |

---

## XII. Usage Instructions

1. Copy the template to the project directory
2. Select the appropriate page template based on content needs
3. **Title is the core takeaway** — ensure each page has a clear conclusion
4. Use three accent colors to differentiate content types (green = recommended, blue = process, orange = emphasis)
5. Generate the final SVG through the Executor role

| **Title Area** | y: 50-100                     |
| **Grid Base**  | 40px                          |

---

## III. Color Scheme

### Primary Colors

| Role             | Value       | Notes                            |
| ---------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------- |
| **Anthropic Orange** | `#D97757` | Brand identity, title emphasis, key data |
| **Deep Space Gray** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover background, body text, chart base |
| **Tech Blue**    | `#4A90D9`   | Flowcharts, links, interactive elements |
| **Mint Green**   | `#10B981`   | Recommended options, positive indicators, success states |
| **Coral Red**    | `#EF4444`   | Risks, cautions, warnings        |

### Neutral Colors

| Role           | Value       | Usage                  |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| **Cloud White** | `#F8FAFC`  | Card background        |
| **Border Gray** | `#E2E8F0`  | Card borders, dividers |
| **Slate Gray** | `#64748B`   | Secondary text, chart labels |
| **Pure White** | `#FFFFFF`   | Page background        |

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Stack

**Font Stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif`

### Font Size Hierarchy

| Level    | Usage            | Size   | Weight  |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------ | ------- |
| H1       | Cover main title | 56px   | Bold    |
| H2       | Page title       | 32-36px| Bold    |
| H3       | Subtitle/section | 24-28px| Semibold|
| H4       | Card title       | 20-22px| Bold    |
| P        | Body content     | 16-18px| Regular |
| Data     | Highlighted data | 40-48px| Bold    |
| Label    | Label text       | 14px   | 500     |
| Sub      | Chart labels/footnotes | 12-14px | Regular |

---

## V. Core Design Principles

### Top-Tier Consulting Style

1. **Conclusion First (Pyramid Principle)**: Each page title is the core takeaway
2. **Data Contextualization**: Comparisons, trends, benchmarks — never present data in isolation
3. **SCQA Framework**: Situation → Complication → Question → Answer
4. **MECE Principle**: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive
5. **Professional Whitespace**: Content ratio < 65%, let information "breathe"

---

## VI. Page Structure

### General Layout

| Area           | Position/Height | Description                            |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| **Top**        | y=0, h=6-8px    | Anthropic Orange decorative bar        |
| **Label**      | y=50-70         | Page type label (uppercase, orange)    |
| **Title Area** | y=80-140        | Page title (core takeaway)             |
| **Content Area** | y=160-620     | Main content area                      |
| **Footer**     | y=680           | Page number (centered)                 |

### Decorative Elements

- **Top Orange Bar**: Anthropic Orange (`#D97757`), height 6px
- **Left Gradient Bar**: Orange gradient (`#D97757` → `#E8956F`)
- **Card Border**: Light gray (`#E2E8F0`)
- **Card Shadow**: Soft shadow effect
- **Grid Decoration Lines**: White low-opacity grid on dark covers

---

## VII. Page Types

### 1. Cover Page (01_cover.svg)

- Dark gradient background (`#1A1A2E` → `#16213E` → `#0F0F1A`)
- Grid decoration lines (white, 3% opacity)
- Orange and blue glow effects
- Neural network-style connection lines and nodes
- Centered main title (white) + subtitle
- Orange decorative short line
- Bottom date and source info

### 2. Table of Contents Page (02_toc.svg)

- White background
- Left orange gradient decorative bar (8px)
- Orange circular numbers + chapter titles
- Right-side complexity progression illustration

### 3. Chapter Page (02_chapter.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Grid decoration
- Centered large chapter title
- Orange decorative line

### 4. Content Page (03_content.svg)

- White background
- Top orange decorative bar
- Page type label (orange uppercase)
- Title as core takeaway
- Three-column card layout (colored top borders)
- Footer with centered page number

### 5. Ending Page (04_ending.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Neural network decoration
- Centered thank-you message
- Contact information

---

## VIII. Common Components

### Card Style

```xml
<!-- Card with shadow -->
<g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
    <path fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1"
          d="M72,180 H408 A12,12 0 0 1 420,192 V588 A12,12 0 0 1 408,600 H72 A12,12 0 0 1 60,588 V192 A12,12 0 0 1 72,180 Z"/>
</g>
<!-- Top colored decorative bar -->
<rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981"/>
```

### Circular Number

```xml
<circle cx="90" cy="200" r="24" fill="#D97757"/>
<text x="90" y="207" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
```

### Icon Background Circle

```xml
<circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
```

---

## IX. Spacing Guidelines

| Element          | Value  |
| ---------------- | ------ |
| Safe margin      | 60px   |
| Card gap         | 30-40px|
| Card border radius | 8-12px |
| Card padding     | 30px   |
| Grid base        | 40px   |

---

## X. SVG Technical Constraints

### Mandatory Rules

1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
2. Use `<rect>` elements for backgrounds
3. Use `<tspan>` for text wrapping (**strictly no** `<foreignObject>`)
4. Use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` for transparency
5. Prohibited: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
6. Prohibited: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`
7. Define gradients using `<defs>`

### PPT Compatibility Rules

- No `<g opacity="...">` (group opacity)
- Inline styles only

---

## XI. Placeholder Specification

| Placeholder        | Description        |

| `{{SUBTITLE}}`     | Subtitle           |

| `{{CHAPTER_TITLE}}`| Chapter title      |
| `{{PAGE_NUM}}`     | Page number        |
| `{{TOTAL_PAGES}}`  | Total pages        |

---

## XII. Usage Instructions

1. Copy the template to the project directory
2. Select the appropriate page template based on content needs
3. **Title is the core takeaway** — ensure each page has a clear conclusion
4. Use three accent colors to differentiate content types (green = recommended, blue = process, orange = emphasis)
5. Generate the final SVG through the Executor role

# VAPO: Value-Model-Based RL for Advanced Reasoning — Design Specification

---

## I. Project Information

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Project Name** | vapo_rl_presentation_ppt169_20260420 |
| **Canvas Format** | PPT 16:9 |
| **Slide Count** | 9 slides |
| **Style** | C) Top Consulting — data-forward, analytical, conclusion-first |
| **Target Audience** | ML researchers and RL practitioners working on LLM reasoning |
| **Scenario** | Technical research presentation (conference / internal sharing) |
| **Template** | anthropic (Anthropic Style Template) |
| **Date** | 2026-04-20 |
| **Presentation Duration** | ~15 minutes |
| **Notes Style** | Formal, technical |
| **Presentation Purpose** | Inform + Persuade (demonstrate VAPO's superiority and motivate adoption of value-model-based RL) |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Format** | Standard 16:9 |
| **Dimensions** | 1280 × 720 px |
| **viewBox** | `0 0 1280 720` |
| **Safe Margins** | 60px (left/right), 50px (top/bottom) |
| **Content Area** | x: 60–1220, y: 100–670 |
| **Title Area** | y: 50–100 |
| **Footer Area** | y: 680–720 |
| **Grid Base** | 40px |

---

## III. Visual Theme

**Style**: Anthropic dark/light hybrid — dark cover & chapter pages, white content pages.
**Tone**: Authoritative, tech-forward, data-driven, rigorous academic meets polished consulting.

### Color Scheme

| Role | HEX | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| **Anthropic Orange** | `#D97757` | Brand accent, key data, title emphasis, callout bars |
| **Deep Space Gray** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover/chapter background, body text on light pages |
| **Tech Blue** | `#4A90D9` | Secondary highlights, framework components, links |
| **Mint Green** | `#10B981` | Positive results, gains, recommended components |
| **Coral Red** | `#EF4444` | Risks, ablation losses, negative delta |
| **Cloud White** | `#F8FAFC` | Card backgrounds |
| **Border Gray** | `#E2E8F0` | Card borders, dividers |
| **Slate Gray** | `#64748B` | Secondary text, chart axis labels |
| **Pure White** | `#FFFFFF` | Page background |

### Chart Data Colors
- VAPO (hero): `#D97757` (Anthropic Orange)

    - Long trajectories amplify bootstrap errors
    - Bias accumulates step-over-step
    - Leads to inaccurate advantage estimates
  - Card 2 — **Heterogeneous Sequence Lengths** (`sliders`, blue top bar):
    - Short vs long responses need different bias-variance tradeoffs
    - Uniform λ in GAE sub-optimal across all lengths
    - No adaptive mechanism in prior work
  - Card 3 — **Reward Signal Sparsity** (`database`, mint top bar):

  - Impact from ablation: Removing Length-Adaptive GAE drops score from 60 → 45 (−15 points)
  - Unique to VAPO — not present in DAPO, GRPO, or VC-PPO
- **Design notes**: Left diagram: x-axis = response length (short→long), y-axis = λ value (0→1), orange curve showing monotonic increase. Right panel: callout box "−15 pts if removed" in red; "NOVEL TECHNIQUE" orange badge.

---

### Slide 6 — Main Results (Light content page)
- **Layout**: Top: bar chart (bar_chart); Bottom: figure_2.jpg embed with annotation callouts
- **Label**: RESULTS
- **Title**: VAPO Scores 60 on AIME 2024 — 10+ Points Above Prior State-of-the-Art
- **Content points**:
  - Bar chart data (AIME 2024 avg@32):
    - Vanilla PPO: 5 (light gray)
    - DeepSeek-R1-Zero-Qwen-32B: 47 (slate gray)
    - DAPO: 50 (tech blue)
    - VAPO: 60 (anthropic orange)
  - Annotation: "+10 pts over DAPO" delta arrow
  - All models on same Qwen2.5-32B base, no SFT data
  - Training curve reference: figure_2.jpg — VAPO reaches 60% at step ~4,500; DAPO plateaus ~50% at 5,500
- **Design notes**: Bar chart top half (~280px), image bottom half. Large "60" data callout in orange next to VAPO bar. Callout on figure_2: "VAPO @ step 4,500" and "DAPO plateau".

---

### Slide 7 — Training Efficiency (Light content page)
- **Layout**: Two-panel side-by-side image layout — figure_2.jpg (left), figure_3.jpg (right)
- **Label**: EFFICIENCY
- **Title**: VAPO Reaches SOTA in ~5,000 Steps With Zero Training Crashes
- **Content points**:
  - Left panel (figure_2.jpg): Accuracy vs training steps
    - VAPO: reaches 60% at ~4,500 steps
    - DAPO: plateaus at ~50% at 5,500 steps
    - DeepSeek-R1-Zero: reaches 47% after ~10,000 steps
    - Callout: "~2× faster to SOTA than DeepSeek-R1-Zero"
  - Right panel (figure_3.jpg): Mean response length over training
    - VAPO: ~6,000 tokens
    - DAPO: ~4,500 tokens
    - Callout: "Longer reasoning chains = more elaborate CoT"
  - Key stat: Zero training crashes across multiple independent runs
- **Design notes**: Two images side-by-side, each ~540px wide. Annotation overlays on each figure. `rocket` icon for efficiency callout. `clock` icon for training steps comparison.

---

### Slide 8 — Ablation Study (Light content page)
- **Layout**: Waterfall chart (custom SVG built from waterfall_chart) with annotated table
- **Label**: ABLATION
- **Title**: Every Component Matters — Value-Pretraining Alone Contributes 49 Points
- **Content points**:
  - Waterfall from VAPO (60) removing components to worst:
    - VAPO full: 60
    - w/o Group-Sampling: 55 (−5)
    - w/o Positive Example LM Loss: 54 (−1)
    - w/o Token-level Loss: 53 (−1)
    - w/o Clip-Higher: 46 (−7)
    - w/o Length-adaptive GAE: 45 (−1)
    - w/o Decoupled-GAE: 33 (−12)
    - w/o Value-Pretraining: 11 (−22)
    - Vanilla PPO baseline: 5
  - Highlighted callouts:
    - "Value-Pretraining: −49 pts if removed" (red, prominent)
    - "Decoupled-GAE: −27 pts if removed" (orange)
    - "Length-Adaptive GAE: −15 pts if removed" (amber)
- **Design notes**: Waterfall bars: green for remaining, red for loss on removal. Three large callout annotations on right. Table below waterfall with exact scores.

---

### Slide 9 — Takeaways (Dark ending theme)
- **Layout**: Dark theme with 4 KPI cards + closing statement
- **Label**: TAKEAWAYS
- **Title**: Value-Model-Based RL Is Back — With the Right Engineering
- **Content points**:
  - KPI card 1 (`badge-check`): **60.4** — AIME 2024 SOTA, +10 pts over DAPO
  - KPI card 2 (`arrow-trend-up`): **~5,000 steps** — Reach SOTA with 2× fewer steps than DeepSeek-R1-Zero
  - KPI card 3 (`bolt`): **49-point gap** — Value-Pretraining is the single most critical component
  - KPI card 4 (`checkmark`): **Zero crashes** — Stable training across all runs
  - Closing bullets:
    1. Value-model-based RL outperforms value-free methods when bias, heterogeneous lengths, and sparsity are systematically addressed
    2. Length-Adaptive GAE is a novel, effective technique for heterogeneous-length reasoning tasks (−15 pts if removed)
    3. Value-Pretraining is non-negotiable — without it, value-model RL barely works (60 → 11)
    4. VAPO sets the new baseline for open reasoning model training on Qwen2.5-32B without SFT
- **Design notes**: Dark gradient background matching cover. Four orange KPI cards (2×2 grid). Closing statement centered at bottom in white italic.

---

## X. Speaker Notes Requirements

- File naming: `01_cover.md`, `02_motivation.md`, `03_challenges.md`, `04_framework.md`, `05_length_gae.md`, `06_results.md`, `07_efficiency.md`, `08_ablation.md`, `09_takeaways.md`
- Master file: `notes/total.md` (uses `#` headings per page)
- Split files: no `#` headings (plain text)
- Style: Formal, technical, written for ML practitioners
- Each slide notes: 3–5 sentences covering key talking points and data context

---

## XI. Technical Constraints Reminder

1. viewBox MUST be `0 0 1280 720` on every SVG
2. No `<foreignObject>`, no `class`, no `<style>` blocks, no `clipPath`, no `mask`
3. Text wrapping: use `<tspan dy="...">` elements only
4. Transparency: use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
5. No `<g opacity="...">` (PPT compatibility)
6. All gradients defined in `<defs>`
7. Inline styles only
8. Image embeds: use `<image href="data:image/jpeg;base64,..." .../>` (post-processed by finalize_svg.py)
9. Icon placeholders: `{{icon:name}}` — only use names from approved inventory in Section VI

---

## XII. Design Checklist

### Pre-generation
- [x] Canvas format confirmed: 1280×720
- [x] Slide count confirmed: 9
- [x] Template selected: anthropic
- [x] Color scheme defined with HEX values
- [x] All chart types mapped to slides
- [x] All icon names verified against icons_index.json
- [x] Image files present in images/ directory
- [x] Content outline complete for all 9 slides

### Post-generation
- [ ] All SVGs have correct viewBox `0 0 1280 720`
- [ ] No forbidden SVG elements present
- [ ] Text fits within safe margins (60px left/right)
- [ ] All data values match source_brief.md exactly
- [ ] Page numbers correct
- [ ] Speaker notes generated for all 9 slides
- [ ] finalize_svg.py run successfully
- [ ] PPTX exported to /app/output/final_deck.pptx

---

## XIII. Next Steps

Images are user-provided (existing) — no AI generation needed.

→ **Proceed directly to Executor phase** (executor-base.md + executor-consultant-top.md)

# Executor Common Guidelines

> Style-specific content is in the corresponding `executor-{style}.md`. Technical constraints are in shared-standards.md.

---

## 1. Template Adherence Rules

If template files exist in the project's `templates/` directory, the template structure must be followed:

| Page Type | Corresponding Template | Adherence Rules |
|-----------|----------------------|-----------------|
| Cover | `01_cover.svg` | Inherit background, decorative elements, layout structure; replace placeholder content |
| Chapter | `02_chapter.svg` | Inherit numbering style, title position, decorative elements |
| Content | `03_content.svg` | Inherit header/footer styles; **content area may be freely laid out** |
| Ending | `04_ending.svg` | Inherit background, thank-you message position, contact info layout |
| TOC | `02_toc.svg` | **Optional**: Inherit TOC title, list styles |

### Page-Template Mapping Declaration (Required Output)

Before generating each page, you must explicitly output which template (or "free design") is used:

```
📝 **Template mapping**: `templates/01_cover.svg` (or "None (free design)")
🎯 **Adherence rules / layout strategy**: [specific description]
```

- **Content pages**: Templates only define header and footer; the content area is freely laid out by the Executor
- **No template**: Generate entirely per the Design Specification & Content Outline

---

## 2. Design Parameter Confirmation (Mandatory Step)

> Before generating the first SVG page, you **must review the key design parameters from the Design Specification & Content Outline** to ensure all subsequent generation strictly follows the spec.

Must output confirmation including: canvas dimensions, body font size, color scheme (primary/secondary/accent HEX values), font plan.

**Why is this step mandatory?** Prevents the "spec says one thing, execution does another" disconnect.

---

## 3. Execution Guidelines

- **Proximity principle**: Place related elements close together to form visual groups; increase spacing between unrelated groups to reinforce logical structure
- **Absolute spec adherence**: Strictly follow the color, layout, canvas format, and typography parameters in the spec
- **Follow template structure**: If templates exist, inherit the template's visual framework
- **Phased batch generation** (recommended):
  1. **Visual Construction Phase**: Generate all SVG pages continuously, ensuring high consistency in design style and layout coordinates (Visual Consistency)

- **English content** → English naming: `01_cover.svg`, `02_agenda.svg`, `03_key_benefits.svg`

After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.

- **Compatible**: Also supports `slide01.md` format (backward compatibility)

# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

86	When the Design Spec includes a **VII. Chart Reference List**, read the referenced SVG templates from `templates/charts/` to understand common chart patterns.
87	
88	**Adaptation rules**:
89	- **Must preserve**: Chart type (bar/line/pie etc.) as specified in the Design Spec
90	- **Must adapt**: Data values, labels, colors (match the project's color scheme), and dimensions to fit the page layout
91	- **May adjust**: Axis ranges, grid lines, legend position, spacing — as long as the chart remains accurate and readable
92	- **Must NOT**: Change chart type without Design Spec justification, or remove data points specified in the outline
93	
94	> Chart templates: `templates/charts/` (33 types). Index: `templates/charts/charts_index.json`
95	
96	---
97	
98	## 6. Image Handling
99	
100	Handle images based on their status in the Design Specification's "Image Resource List":
101	
102	| Status | Source | Handling |
103	|--------|--------|----------|
104	| **Existing** | User-provided | Reference images directly from `../images/` directory |
105	| **AI-generated** | Generated by Image_Generator | Images already in `../images/`, reference directly |
106	| **Placeholder** | Not yet prepared | Use dashed border placeholder |
107	
108	**Reference**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" ... preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
109	
110	**Placeholder**: Dashed border `<rect stroke-dasharray="8,4" .../>` + description text
111	
112	---
113	
114	## 7. Font Usage
115	
116	Apply corresponding fonts for different text roles based on the font plan in the Design Specification & Content Outline:
117	
118	| Role | Chinese Recommended | English Recommended |
119	|------|--------------------|--------------------|
120	| Title font | Microsoft YaHei / KaiTi / SimHei | Arial / Georgia |
121	| Body font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Calibri / Times |
122	| Emphasis font | SimHei | Arial Black / Consolas |
123	| Annotation font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Arial / Times |
124	
125	---
126	
127	## 8. Speaker Notes Generation Framework
128	
129	### Task 1. Generate Complete Speaker Notes Document
130	
131	After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.
132	
133	**Why not generate page-by-page?** Batch-writing notes allows planning transitions like a script, ensuring coherent presentation logic.
134	
135	**Format**: Each page starts with `# <number>_<page_title>`, separated by `---` between pages. Each page includes: script text (2-5 sentences), `Key points: ① ② ③`, `Duration: X minutes`. Except for the first page, each page's text starts with a `[Transition]` phrase.
136	
137	**Basic stage direction markers** (common to all styles):
138	
139	| Marker | Purpose |
140	|--------|---------|
141	| `[Pause]` | Whitespace after key content, letting the audience absorb |
142	| `[Transition]` | Standalone paragraph at the start of each page's text, bridging from the previous page |
143	
144	> Each style may extend with additional markers (`[Interactive]`/`[Data]`/`[Scan Room]`/`[Benchmark]` etc.), see `executor-{style}.md`.
145	
146	**Requirements**:
147	
148	- Notes should be conversational and flow naturally
149	- Highlight each page's core information and presentation key points
150	- Users can manually edit and override in the `notes/` directory
151	
152	### Task 2. Split Into Per-Page Note Files
153	
154	Automatically split `notes/total.md` into individual speaker note files in the `notes/` directory.
155	
156	**File naming convention**:
157	
158	- **Recommended**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.svg` → `notes/01_cover.md`)
159	- **Compatible**: Also supports `slide01.md` format (backward compatibility)
160	
161	---
162	
163	## 9. Next Steps After Completion
164	
165	> **Auto-continuation**: After Visual Construction Phase (all SVG pages) and Logic Construction Phase (all notes) are complete, the Executor proceeds directly to the post-processing pipeline.
166	
167	**Post-processing & Export** (see [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md)):

169	```bash
170	# 1. Split speaker notes
171	python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>
172	
173	# 2. SVG post-processing (auto-embed icons, images, etc.)
174	python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
175	
176	# 3. Export PPTX
177	python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
178	# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
179	```

12	
13	## SCQA Framework (Narrative Structure)
14	
15	Every MBB-level presentation follows the SCQA narrative structure:
16	
17	| Element | Purpose | Typical Pages |
18	|---------|---------|---------------|
19	| **S - Situation** | Establish shared context | Cover / Pages 1-2 |
20	| **C - Complication** | Introduce the problem / tension | Pages 2-3 |
21	| **Q - Question** | The implicit or explicit question to solve | Transition page |
22	| **A - Answer** | Core solution | All body pages |
23	
24	**Page sequencing**: Cover embodies S+C → Executive Summary answers Q → Chapters develop A → Closing revisits S
25	
26	**Title writing**:
27	
28	| SCQA Element | Weak Title | MBB-level Title |
29	|-------------|------------|-----------------|
30	| S | "Industry Background" | "Digital penetration surpasses 60%, industry enters deep waters" |
31	| C | "Challenges Faced" | "Yet three structural contradictions constrain scaled deployment" |
32	| Q | "Strategic Question" | "How to move from pilot to full deployment within 18 months?" |
33	| A | "Solution" | "Three-phase path: Focus, Expand, Scale" |
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Data Contextualization (Never Present Data in Isolation)
38	
39	> **Golden Rule**: Never display a single data point in isolation. Every number needs context.
40	
41	| Method | Pattern | Visual Implementation |
42	|--------|---------|----------------------|
43	| **Time comparison** | "From X to Y" | Line chart + arrow annotating magnitude of change |
44	| **Benchmark** | "X vs industry average Y" | Bar chart with gray dashed baseline |
45	| **Competitive comparison** | "Us X vs Competitor Y" | Side-by-side bar chart, highlight own data |
46	| **Target gap** | "Actual X / Target Y" | Progress bar + gap annotation |
47	| **Ranking** | "Ranked #N of M" | Horizontal bar chart + highlight marker |
48	
49	**Data annotation three essentials**: Every data visualization must include (1) The value itself (large bold font) (2) Comparison reference (baseline / prior period / competitor) (3) Meaning interpretation ("So what?")
50	
51	```xml
52	<text x="160" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-size="42" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">97.3%</text>
53	<text x="160" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#64748B">Industry avg 82% | Competitor A 89%</text>
54	<text x="160" y="335" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#059669">Leading industry by 15.3 percentage points</text>
55	```
56	
57	---
58	
59	## Pyramid Principle (Conclusion First)
60	
61	> Executives don't care about your *process* — they care about *results*.
62	
63	```
64	         ┌─────────────────┐
65	         │  Core Conclusion │   ← Page title / Takeaway
66	         └────────┬────────┘
67	      ┌───────────┼───────────┐
68	  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐
69	  │ Arg 1 │  │ Arg 2 │  │ Arg 3 │   ← Key supporting points
70	  └───────┘  └───────┘  └───────┘
71	```
72	
73	| Level | Position | Font Size |
74	|-------|----------|-----------|
75	| Core conclusion | Takeaway Box | 16-18px bold |
76	| Arguments | Content area body | 14-16px |
77	| Supporting data | Charts / cards | 12-14px |
78	
79	**Contrast**: Title "Market Research Results" (wrong) → "Metaverse needs 5-10 years to reach scale" (right); Body "We researched... and found..." (wrong) → "Three arguments: (1)... (2)... (3)..." (right)
80	
81	---
82	
83	## MBB-level Layout Patterns
84	
85	### Content Page Standard Structure (1280x720)
86	
87	```
88	┌──────────────────────────────────┐
89	│ Gradient top bar (0,0 → 1280,6)  │
90	├──────────────────────────────────┤
91	│ Assertion title (x=40, y=50, 24px)│
92	├──────────────────────────────────┤
93	│ Takeaway Box (x=40, y=75,        │  ← Dark background + white text, one-sentence conclusion
94	│   w=1200, h=45)                  │
95	├──────────────────────────────────┤
96	│ Content area (x=40, y=140,       │  ← Charts / data / analysis
97	│   w=1200, h=520)                 │
98	├──────────────────────────────────┤
99	│ Source | CONFIDENTIAL | Page #    │  ← y=700, 10px
100	└──────────────────────────────────┘
101	```
102	
103	### Strategic Roadmap
104	
105	Three phases laid out horizontally, `<rect rx="8">` + title + action list, `<polygon>` arrows connecting:
106	
107	```
108	Focus Core (0-6mo)  ──>  Expand Capability (6-12mo)  ──>  Scale Up (12-18mo)
109	x=40,w=380              x=450,w=380                     x=860,w=380
110	```
111	
112	### Benchmarking Matrix
113	
114	Horizontal table; own row highlighted in theme color, others in gray. Leading indicators marked green, lagging marked red. Use `<circle>` or `<rect>` to build score points.
115	
116	### Waterfall Chart (Change Attribution)
117	
118	Start → increase/decrease factors → End. Positive factors green bars, negative factors red bars, start/end points dark bars, cumulative line as dashed connector.
119	
120	---
121	
122	## Strategic Use of Color
123	
124	MBB-level color usage is extremely restrained — color serves information:
125	
126	| Purpose | Method |
127	|---------|--------|
128	| **Focus** | Target data in theme color, everything else gray |
129	| **Reduce cognitive load** | Same series differentiated by opacity (`fill-opacity` 1.0/0.6/0.3) |
130	| **Semantics** | Green = positive, Red = negative, Gray = baseline |
131	| **Branding** | Gradient top bar / decorative lines in brand color |
132	
133	**Commandments**: No more than 3 primary colors; accent color used at most 2-3 places globally; data series use same-hue depth variations, not different colors; background white or very light gray.
134	
135	---
136	
137	## Chart vs Table Selection Matrix
138	
139	| Scenario | Recommended Form | Reason |
140	|----------|-----------------|--------|
141	| Comparing 2-7 categories | **Bar chart** | Visual comparison is intuitive |
142	| Time trends | **Line chart** | Time series clarity |
143	| Precise values / large rankings | **Table** | 50 data points in a bar chart would be chaotic |
144	| Proportional composition | **Donut chart** | More modern than pie charts |
145	| Two-dimensional positioning | **2x2 matrix** | Strategic quadrant analysis |
146	| Change attribution | **Waterfall chart** | Factor decomposition |
147	
148	---
149	
150	## Speaker Notes Style
151	
152	### Narrative Tone
153	
154	Targeting **executives / decision-makers**. Pyramid structure — every sentence carries information. Composed, authoritative, and insightful tone.
155	
156	### Stage Direction Markers
157	
158	| Marker | Purpose | Example |
159	|--------|---------|---------|
160	| `[Pause]` | Silence after key insight, let executives absorb | "This means we are missing a billion-dollar market. [Pause]" |
161	| `[Scan Room]` | Observe decision-makers' reactions, decide whether to elaborate | "[Scan Room] If there are questions, I can elaborate." |
162	| `[Data]` | Conversational number delivery | "[Data] 63% → nearly two-thirds" |
163	| `[Benchmark]` | Emphasize comparison baseline | "[Benchmark] Compared to the industry average of 12%, our 23% is nearly double" |
164	| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Building on the strategic framework, let's drill into the implementation path." |
165	
166	### Notes Writing Guidelines
167	
168	- **Pyramid structure**: Conclusion → Arguments → Details
169	- **Data contextualization**: Every number has a comparison reference
170	- **Executive language**: "The strategic implication is...", "The core insight is..."
171	- **Flex mechanism**: Annotate "content that can be skipped if time is tight" for flexible duration
172	- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core insight (2) Data support (3) Strategic implication`
173	
174	### Notes Example
175	
176	```markdown
177	# 03_strategic_path
178	
179	[Transition] Having clarified the problem and the opportunity, now comes the most critical part — our response path.
180	
181	We recommend a three-phase strategy. [Pause]
182	
183	Phase one: Focus. Over the next six months, concentrate resources on conquering the Eastern China market.
184	[Data] Eastern China contributes nearly two-thirds of industry growth, [Benchmark] yet our penetration rate is only half of Competitor A's. [Pause]
185	
186	Phase two: Expand. Use Eastern China as a template, replicate to Southern and Northern China.
187	Phase three: Scale. Leverage a digital platform for nationwide coverage.
188	
189	[Scan Room] The resource allocation for phase one is in the appendix — would you like me to walk through it now?
190	
191	Key points: (1) Focus-Expand-Scale three-phase approach (2) Data-backed Eastern China priority (3) 18-month full deployment
192	Duration: 3 minutes
193	Flex: [If time is tight, skip phase two and three details and go straight to financial impact]
194	```
195	
196	---
197

199	
200	### Content Level
201	
202	- [ ] **SCQA complete**: Overall follows Situation-Complication-Question-Answer structure
203	- [ ] **Data contextualized**: Every data point has a comparison reference
204	- [ ] **Conclusion first**: Every page's Takeaway Box has a one-sentence conclusion
205	- [ ] **MECE principle**: Categorized analysis is mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive
206

208	
209	- [ ] **Color with intent**: Colors serve information delivery
210	- [ ] **Ample whitespace**: Not crowded; information can "breathe"
211	- [ ] **Visual hierarchy**: Conclusion > Arguments > Details, differentiated by font size/weight
212	- [ ] **Brand consistency**: Gradient top bar and footer unified throughout
213	
214	### Notes Level
215	
216	- [ ] **Pyramid structure**: Every page is conclusion-first
217	- [ ] **Stage markers complete**: [Pause] and [Scan Room] at key positions
218	- [ ] **Flex content annotated**: Supports flexible duration

# Executor Consultant Top — Top-tier Consulting Style (MBB Level)

> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.

---

## Role Definition

An MBB-level (McKinsey / Bain / BCG) top-tier consulting style SVG design executor. Suitable for strategic planning, board presentations, investment roadshows, C-suite decision support, and other **premium consulting** scenarios. Core characteristics: data-driven insights, pyramid-structured narrative, extreme simplicity. Output targets C-level decision-makers.

---

## SCQA Framework (Narrative Structure)

Every MBB-level presentation follows the SCQA narrative structure:

| Element | Purpose | Typical Pages |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| **S - Situation** | Establish shared context | Cover / Pages 1-2 |
| **C - Complication** | Introduce the problem / tension | Pages 2-3 |
| **Q - Question** | The implicit or explicit question to solve | Transition page |
| **A - Answer** | Core solution | All body pages |

**Page sequencing**: Cover embodies S+C → Executive Summary answers Q → Chapters develop A → Closing revisits S

**Title writing**:

| SCQA Element | Weak Title | MBB-level Title |
|-------------|------------|-----------------|
| S | "Industry Background" | "Digital penetration surpasses 60%, industry enters deep waters" |
| C | "Challenges Faced" | "Yet three structural contradictions constrain scaled deployment" |

1	# Executor Consultant Top — Top-tier Consulting Style (MBB Level)
2	
3	> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Role Definition
8	
9	An MBB-level (McKinsey / Bain / BCG) top-tier consulting style SVG design executor. Suitable for strategic planning, board presentations, investment roadshows, C-suite decision support, and other **premium consulting** scenarios. Core characteristics: data-driven insights, pyramid-structured narrative, extreme simplicity. Output targets C-level decision-makers.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## SCQA Framework (Narrative Structure)
14	
15	Every MBB-level presentation follows the SCQA narrative structure:
16	
17	| Element | Purpose | Typical Pages |
18	|---------|---------|---------------|
19	| **S - Situation** | Establish shared context | Cover / Pages 1-2 |
20	| **C - Complication** | Introduce the problem / tension | Pages 2-3 |
21	| **Q - Question** | The implicit or explicit question to solve | Transition page |
22	| **A - Answer** | Core solution | All body pages |
23	
24	**Page sequencing**: Cover embodies S+C → Executive Summary answers Q → Chapters develop A → Closing revisits S
25	
26	**Title writing**:
27	
28	| SCQA Element | Weak Title | MBB-level Title |
29	|-------------|------------|-----------------|
30	| S | "Industry Background" | "Digital penetration surpasses 60%, industry enters deep waters" |
31	| C | "Challenges Faced" | "Yet three structural contradictions constrain scaled deployment" |
32	| Q | "Strategic Question" | "How to move from pilot to full deployment within 18 months?" |
33	| A | "Solution" | "Three-phase path: Focus, Expand, Scale" |
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Data Contextualization (Never Present Data in Isolation)
38	
39	> **Golden Rule**: Never display a single data point in isolation. Every number needs context.
40	
41	| Method | Pattern | Visual Implementation |
42	|--------|---------|----------------------|
43	| **Time comparison** | "From X to Y" | Line chart + arrow annotating magnitude of change |
44	| **Benchmark** | "X vs industry average Y" | Bar chart with gray dashed baseline |
45	| **Competitive comparison** | "Us X vs Competitor Y" | Side-by-side bar chart, highlight own data |
46	| **Target gap** | "Actual X / Target Y" | Progress bar + gap annotation |
47	| **Ranking** | "Ranked #N of M" | Horizontal bar chart + highlight marker |
48	
49	**Data annotation three essentials**: Every data visualization must include (1) The value itself (large bold font) (2) Comparison reference (baseline / prior period / competitor) (3) Meaning interpretation ("So what?")
50	
51	```xml
52	<text x="160" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-size="42" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">97.3%</text>
53	<text x="160" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#64748B">Industry avg 82% | Competitor A 89%</text>
54	<text x="160" y="335" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#059669">Leading industry by 15.3 percentage points</text>
55	```
56	
57	---
58	
59	## Pyramid Principle (Conclusion First)
60	
61	> Executives don't care about your *process* — they care about *results*.
62	
63	```
64	         ┌─────────────────┐
65	         │  Core Conclusion │   ← Page title / Takeaway
66	         └────────┬────────┘
67	      ┌───────────┼───────────┐
68	  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐
69	  │ Arg 1 │  │ Arg 2 │  │ Arg 3 │   ← Key supporting points
70	  └───────┘  └───────┘  └───────┘
71	```
72	
73	| Level | Position | Font Size |
74	|-------|----------|-----------|
75	| Core conclusion | Takeaway Box | 16-18px bold |
76	| Arguments | Content area body | 14-16px |
77	| Supporting data | Charts / cards | 12-14px |
78	
79	**Contrast**: Title "Market Research Results" (wrong) → "Metaverse needs 5-10 years to reach scale" (right); Body "We researched... and found..." (wrong) → "Three arguments: (1)... (2)... (3)..." (right)
80	
81	---
82	
83	## MBB-level Layout Patterns
84	
85	### Content Page Standard Structure (1280x720)
86	
87	```
88	┌──────────────────────────────────┐
89	│ Gradient top bar (0,0 → 1280,6)  │
90	├──────────────────────────────────┤
91	│ Assertion title (x=40, y=50, 24px)│
92	├──────────────────────────────────┤
93	│ Takeaway Box (x=40, y=75,        │  ← Dark background + white text, one-sentence conclusion
94	│   w=1200, h=45)                  │
95	├──────────────────────────────────┤
96	│ Content area (x=40, y=140,       │  ← Charts / data / analysis
97	│   w=1200, h=520)                 │
98	├──────────────────────────────────┤
99	│ Source | CONFIDENTIAL | Page #    │  ← y=700, 10px
100	└──────────────────────────────────┘
101	```
102	
103	### Strategic Roadmap
104	
105	Three phases laid out horizontally, `<rect rx="8">` + title + action list, `<polygon>` arrows connecting:
106	
107	```
108	Focus Core (0-6mo)  ──>  Expand Capability (6-12mo)  ──>  Scale Up (12-18mo)
109	x=40,w=380              x=450,w=380                     x=860,w=380
110	```
111	
112	### Benchmarking Matrix
113	
114	Horizontal table; own row highlighted in theme color, others in gray. Leading indicators marked green, lagging marked red. Use `<circle>` or `<rect>` to build score points.
115	
116	### Waterfall Chart (Change Attribution)
117	
118	Start → increase/decrease factors → End. Positive factors green bars, negative factors red bars, start/end points dark bars, cumulative line as dashed connector.
119	
120	---
121	
122	## Strategic Use of Color
123	
124	MBB-level color usage is extremely restrained — color serves information:
125	
126	| Purpose | Method |
127	|---------|--------|
128	| **Focus** | Target data in theme color, everything else gray |
129	| **Reduce cognitive load** | Same series differentiated by opacity (`fill-opacity` 1.0/0.6/0.3) |
130	| **Semantics** | Green = positive, Red = negative, Gray = baseline |
131	| **Branding** | Gradient top bar / decorative lines in brand color |
132	
133	**Commandments**: No more than 3 primary colors; accent color used at most 2-3 places globally; data series use same-hue depth variations, not different colors; background white or very light gray.
134	
135	---
136	
137	## Chart vs Table Selection Matrix
138	
139	| Scenario | Recommended Form | Reason |
140	|----------|-----------------|--------|
141	| Comparing 2-7 categories | **Bar chart** | Visual comparison is intuitive |
142	| Time trends | **Line chart** | Time series clarity |
143	| Precise values / large rankings | **Table** | 50 data points in a bar chart would be chaotic |
144	| Proportional composition | **Donut chart** | More modern than pie charts |
145	| Two-dimensional positioning | **2x2 matrix** | Strategic quadrant analysis |
146	| Change attribution | **Waterfall chart** | Factor decomposition |
147	
148	---
149	
150	## Speaker Notes Style
151	
152	### Narrative Tone
153	
154	Targeting **executives / decision-makers**. Pyramid structure — every sentence carries information. Composed, authoritative, and insightful tone.
155

158	| Marker | Purpose | Example |
159	|--------|---------|---------|
160	| `[Pause]` | Silence after key insight, let executives absorb | "This means we are missing a billion-dollar market. [Pause]" |
161	| `[Scan Room]` | Observe decision-makers' reactions, decide whether to elaborate | "[Scan Room] If there are questions, I can elaborate." |
162	| `[Data]` | Conversational number delivery | "[Data] 63% → nearly two-thirds" |
163	| `[Benchmark]` | Emphasize comparison baseline | "[Benchmark] Compared to the industry average of 12%, our 23% is nearly double" |
164	| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Building on the strategic framework, let's drill into the implementation path." |
165	
166	### Notes Writing Guidelines
167	
168	- **Pyramid structure**: Conclusion → Arguments → Details
169	- **Data contextualization**: Every number has a comparison reference
170	- **Executive language**: "The strategic implication is...", "The core insight is..."
171	- **Flex mechanism**: Annotate "content that can be skipped if time is tight" for flexible duration
172	- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core insight (2) Data support (3) Strategic implication`
173	
174	### Notes Example

181	We recommend a three-phase strategy. [Pause]

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    柱状图模板
    用途: 类别数据对比
    适用场景: 销售额对比、区域排名、年度数据对比
    支持: 6个柱子（可调整为3-8个）
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 柱状图渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="barGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="barShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各区域销售额对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="115" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年第三季度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="450" x2="1160" y2="450" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="350" x2="1160" y2="350" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="250" x2="1160" y2="250" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="1160" y2="150" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="555" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="455" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>50</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="255" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>150</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="155" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- X轴和Y轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="140" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱子数据 (柱宽50px, 间距130px, 总间距180px) -->
        
        <!-- 柱子1: 华东 - 185M (370px高度, 每100M=200px) -->
        <rect x="220" y="180" width="50" height="370" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="245" y="165" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>185</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="245" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华东</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子2: 华南 - 142M -->
        <rect x="400" y="266" width="50" height="284" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="425" y="251" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>142</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="425" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子3: 华北 - 128M -->
        <rect x="580" y="294" width="50" height="256" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="605" y="279" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>128</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="605" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华北</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子4: 西南 - 96M -->
        <rect x="760" y="358" width="50" height="192" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="785" y="343" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>96</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="785" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>西南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子5: 华中 - 73M -->
        <rect x="940" y="404" width="50" height="146" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="965" y="389" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>73</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="965" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华中</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子6: 东北 - 52M -->
        <rect x="1120" y="446" width="50" height="104" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad3)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="1145" y="431" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>52</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1145" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>东北</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="920" y="620" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad1)"/>
        <text x="945" y="632" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高增长区域 (>100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="645" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad2)"/>
        <text x="945" y="657" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>稳定区域 (50-100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="670" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad3)"/>
        <text x="945" y="682" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>潜力区域 (<50M)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="60" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6">
        <tspan>数据来源: 销售部门统计</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    柱状图模板
    用途: 类别数据对比
    适用场景: 销售额对比、区域排名、年度数据对比
    支持: 6个柱子（可调整为3-8个）
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 柱状图渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="barGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="barShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各区域销售额对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="115" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年第三季度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="450" x2="1160" y2="450" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="350" x2="1160" y2="350" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="250" x2="1160" y2="250" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="1160" y2="150" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="555" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="455" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>50</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="255" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>150</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="155" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- X轴和Y轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="140" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱子数据 (柱宽50px, 间距130px, 总间距180px) -->
        
        <!-- 柱子1: 华东 - 185M (370px高度, 每100M=200px) -->
        <rect x="220" y="180" width="50" height="370" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="245" y="165" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>185</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="245" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华东</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子2: 华南 - 142M -->
        <rect x="400" y="266" width="50" height="284" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="425" y="251" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>142</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="425" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子3: 华北 - 128M -->
        <rect x="580" y="294" width="50" height="256" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="605" y="279" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>128</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="605" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华北</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子4: 西南 - 96M -->
        <rect x="760" y="358" width="50" height="192" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="785" y="343" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>96</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="785" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>西南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子5: 华中 - 73M -->
        <rect x="940" y="404" width="50" height="146" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="965" y="389" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>73</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="965" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华中</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子6: 东北 - 52M -->
        <rect x="1120" y="446" width="50" height="104" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad3)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="1145" y="431" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>52</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1145" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>东北</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="920" y="620" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad1)"/>
        <text x="945" y="632" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高增长区域 (>100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="645" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad2)"/>
        <text x="945" y="657" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>稳定区域 (50-100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="670" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad3)"/>
        <text x="945" y="682" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>潜力区域 (<50M)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="60" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6">
        <tspan>数据来源: 销售部门统计</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    瀑布图模板
    用途: 增减变化分析、财务分解
    适用场景: 利润分解、预算变化、成本分析、收入构成
    支持: 起始值 + 6个变化项 + 结束值
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 增加项渐变（绿色） -->
        <linearGradient id="increaseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 减少项渐变（红色） -->
        <linearGradient id="decreaseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#EF5350;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D32F2F;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 总计项渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="totalGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="barShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>年度利润变化分析</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2024年 vs 2025年 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(880, 70)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#totalGrad)"/>
        <text x="28" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>起止值</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="100" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#increaseGrad)"/>
        <text x="128" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>增加</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="190" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#decreaseGrad)"/>
        <text x="218" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>减少</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1200" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="480" x2="1200" y2="480" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="400" x2="1200" y2="400" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="320" x2="1200" y2="320" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="240" x2="1200" y2="240" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="160" x2="1200" y2="160" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="565" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>0</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="485" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>100</tspan></text>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    瀑布图模板
    用途: 增减变化分析、财务分解
    适用场景: 利润分解、预算变化、成本分析、收入构成
    支持: 起始值 + 6个变化项 + 结束值
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 增加项渐变（绿色） -->
        <linearGradient id="increaseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 减少项渐变（红色） -->
        <linearGradient id="decreaseGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#EF5350;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D32F2F;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 总计项渐变（蓝色） -->
        <linearGradient id="totalGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="barShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>年度利润变化分析</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2024年 vs 2025年 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(880, 70)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#totalGrad)"/>
        <text x="28" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>起止值</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="100" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#increaseGrad)"/>
        <text x="128" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>增加</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="190" y="0" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="url(#decreaseGrad)"/>
        <text x="218" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>减少</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">

        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1200" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="480" x2="1200" y2="480" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="400" x2="1200" y2="400" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="320" x2="1200" y2="320" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="240" x2="1200" y2="240" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="160" x2="1200" y2="160" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="565" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>0</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="485" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>100</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="405" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>200</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="325" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>300</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="245" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>400</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="165" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>500</tspan></text>
        
        <!-- 坐标轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="130" x2="140" y2="560" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1200" y2="560" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 
        数据说明：
        - 2024年利润: 280M (起始)

        <rect x="175" y="336" width="90" height="224" rx="4" fill="url(#totalGrad)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>

              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>2024年</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="220" y="618" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>利润</tspan>
        </text>

        <line x1="265" y1="336" x2="305" y2="336" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱2: 营收增长 +120M（从280开始向上） -->
        <rect x="305" y="240" width="90" height="96" rx="4" fill="url(#increaseGrad)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>

            <tspan>营收增长</tspan>
        </text>

        <line x1="395" y1="240" x2="435" y2="240" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱3: 新产品 +65M（从400开始向上） -->
        <rect x="435" y="188" width="90" height="52" rx="4" fill="url(#increaseGrad)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>

        <text x="480" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>新产品</tspan>

        <!-- 连接线 -->
        <line x1="525" y1="188" x2="565" y2="188" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱4: 原材料涨价 -45M（从465开始向下） -->

            <tspan>-45</tspan>

        <text x="610" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif"

            <tspan>原材料</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="610" y="618" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>涨价</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 连接线 -->
        <line x1="655" y1="224" x2="695" y2="224" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱5: 人力成本 -35M（从420开始向下） -->

        </text>
        
        <!-- 连接线 -->
        <line x1="785" y1="252" x2="825" y2="252" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱6: 营销投入 -25M（从385开始向下） -->

        <text x="870" y="288" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"

            <tspan>-25</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="870" y="600" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>营销投入</tspan>
        </text>

        <line x1="915" y1="272" x2="955" y2="272" stroke="#BDC3C7" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
